key.name: api-key
key.description: Google Gemini API Key for authentication.

key.name: model
key.description: Gemini model to use for generating responses.

key.name: models-sequence
key.description: Sequence of models to fallback to when rate limit is reached.

key.name: system-instruction
key.default: "You are Gnome Gemini, an intelligent assistant integrated into GNOME Shell desktop. Be concise and helpful."
key.description: System instruction to guide Gemini behavior.

key.name: remember-history
key.description: Whether to send previous messages in the current conversation to the model.

key.name: popup-position
key.description: Where the Gemini popup opens: 'corner' for the top panel menu or 'center' for a centered modal dialog (80% display size).

key.name: toggle-shortcut
key.description: Keyboard shortcut to open and close the Gemini popup.
